messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Sterling & Rowe Team,

Your Dubai-based executive and board search work across the GCC, including government and public-sector leadership, makes this a relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major natural-resources operation.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where institutional relationships, regulatory execution, reputation, stakeholder confidence and responsible growth intersect. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, and I am internationally mobile for expatriate assignments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
